t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Clock and Dance / Barbapileup
d: The barbababies prepare a show for Barbamama's birthday. While Barbalala finishes up, they go to the carnival where Barbabeau gets stuck in an attraction. // Three separate stories telescope into a big final bouquet in the middle of the courtyard.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Relay Tales / The Barbababies' World
d: Barbalib, Barbalala and Barbabelle take turns as narrators to tell a story, each one bringing a very personal touch to it. // The Barbapapa family spends a day at the beach. Divided into 2 teams, the barbababies fight over a sandy peninsula.

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - The Curse of the Gold Falcon / The Island of Lost Things
d: Santiago and crew set sail to return the Golden Falcon idol back to it's rightful resting place. // When Santiago's magic sword is transported to the Island of Lost Things, the good pirates have to track it down by getting themselves lost!

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Tomas's Birthday Surprise / Family Treasure Hunt
d: Santiago, Lorelai and Abuelo traverse treacherous waters to bring Tomas a special birthday surprise. // It's a good ol' fashioned family competition as everyone pairs up to find the fabled treasure of La Caverna Secreta.

t: Blue's Clues & You S4 - Blue's Breaking News
d: This just in: Josh and Blue are playing reporters and bringing you household news! But when Pail's sandcastle gets knocked over, it's a major story. We have to play Blue's Clues to get the scoop, talk to experts, and figure out what happened.

t: Peppa Pig S8 - Grandpa Pig's Birthday
d: It is Grandpa Pig's birthday and the family go out for a special birthday meal. Peppa has never been to a restaurant before.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Sun, Sea and Snow
d: Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the beach where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow!

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Grandpa Pig's Computer
d: Mummy Pig gives her old PC to Granny and Grandpa Pig. Will they be able to use it?

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Hospital
d: Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is in hospital with a broken leg.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Spring
d: Grandpa Pig organises a chocolate egg hunt for Peppa and her friends. Will the piglets track down the treats?

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
d: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and her family for a ride in her rescue helicopter.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Baby Alexander
d: Baby Alexander is too young to talk, until Peppa teaches him his first word.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
d: Granddad Dog takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Miss Rabbit's Day Off
d: Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket - and everywhere else she works!

t: Peppa Pig S4 - The Secret Club
d: Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Agent Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join!

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
d: Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Shake, Rattle and Bang
d: Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.

t: DORA S3 - Ratoncito Perez / The Berry Hungry Caterpillar
d: Dora helps Ratoncito Perez fix his magic toothbrush wand so she can get a gift for her missing tooth. // Dora meets Carlos, a giant caterpillar who wants to be a butterfly! They need to find some butterberries that will help him transform.

t: DORA S4 - Captain Dora
d: Dora and Boots track down the Pirate Piggies' ship and save it from a kraken!

t: Mr. Crocodile S1 - Borrower Daisy / Can Do Croc
d: Mr. Crocodile and Daisy try to figure out which of her friends borrowed her game and didn't return it. // A perfect "Step-Mother's" day for Maggie all depends on Daisy and Mr. Crocodile finding a can opener.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire
d: The twins visit Barbabright's room. // If I were a billionaire, what would I do to achieve my dreams?

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Rebels
d: Barbidur and Barbalala become little rebels.

t: Rubble & Crew S5 - The Crew Builds A Giant Rock-Climbing Wall / The Crew Builds A Giant Octo-Sandbox
d: Rubble & Crew use their vehicles to 'rock climb' up a giant mountain to rescue Speed Meister! // When there's no room to play inside a sandbox, the pups build a giant octopus with eight sides leading to different sandboxes to play in!

t: Rubble & Crew S1 - The Crew Builds A Super Tub
d: When Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

t: PAW Patrol S12 - Pups Save a Big Brother / Pups Save a Giant Baby
d: Farmer Al and Yumi are expecting a baby when Al thinks his beloved goat Garby is running away. // Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

t: PAW Patrol S4 - Pups Save a Sleepover
d: Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover.

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - The Legend of Capitan Calavera
d: When Santiago discovers the lost treasure of the legendary Capitan Calavera, he and his friends become the new Pirate Protectors of Isla Encanto.

t: Peppa Pig S8 - Mr Bull the Teacher
d: Madame Gazelle must go to the dentist so leaves the class with Mr Bull. The children already know the subjects Mr Bull suggests teaching, so he decides to show them how to fix a squeaky floorboard.

t: Peppa Pig S8 - Looking for Things
d: Mummy Pig is baking an apple pie, so Daddy Pig suggests Peppa and George play a game of looking for things. Peppa and George have fun running around the house solving the clues.

t: Peppa Pig S8 - Poems
d: Madame Gazelle introduces the children to poetry, explaining how sounds can be poems too. Together they make a poem about rain and perform it to the parents.

t: Peppa Pig S8 - Please and Thank You
d: Granny and Grandpa talk to Peppa and George about manners. Madame Gazelle teaches all the children about how wonderful it is to say please and thank you.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
d: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Summer Camp I
d: Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island.

t: PAW Patrol S12 - Katie's Arctic Road Trip / Pups Save A Magical Misha
d: Skye, Everest, Liberty, and Katie go on a camping adventure where they encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth. // When Julia and Julius put on a twin-credible magic show, they are convinced they accidently turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit.

t: PAW Patrol S11 - Pups Save the Puppets
d: Julius and Julia get into a sticky situation.

t: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Bowling Alley / The Crew Builds A Superbloom Path
d: Rubble & the pups find Grandpa Gravel's lucky bowling ball. Too bad Builder Cove doesn't have a bowling alley... until now! // When a sudden superbloom traps Motor, Lily, and Park Ranger Rose, the pups need a flower-friendly construction solution.

t: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Celebrates Builder Covegiving Day / The Crew Builds A Rocket Ship Ride
d: After Speed Meister sabotages Builder Covegiving Day, it's up to the pups to save the holiday for everyone in Builder Cove. // Mix dreams about giving the moon a Mix makeover. Rubble and the pups make her dream a reality with a new boardwalk ride!

t: DORA S2 - Crabby Wedding / The Cloud Kingdom
d: Dora's crab friends are getting married but Swiper swipes the ring and loses it in the ocean. Dora has to get the ring back! / Dora and Boots meet Vicky the Vicuna who is missing her magic flute that she needs to go back to the Cloud Kingdom.

t: DORA S2 - Partly Claudia / Ranita's Magic Stripes
d: Dora and Boots take Claudia, an energetic young rain cloud, to rain on a dry water slide. / Boots gets a case of Tickle Tail that Ranita the Frog can cure if she gets her magic stripes by helping friends around the Rainforest.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Barbabravo Is Not Feeling Well / Be Patient Barbabravo...
d: Following a misadventure, Barbabravo is unable to transform at all. The whole family unites to help him. // Barbabravo can't stay put and is unable to focus one an activity for very long. Barbalala offers to teach him control. Will she succeed?

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - The Seven Foods / The Perfect Portrait
d: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them. // Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore. The whole family helps by suggesting new subjects to paint.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Moving Mission / Barbabright's Invention
d: During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith. // Barbabright has a stroke of genius: the invention of the "BAM".

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Princess For A Day / Barbabeau's Adventure
d: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. // Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Summer Camp I / Summer Camp II
d: Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island. // The Barbababies, the twins, and Mr. Strict set sail on "Thesee", a magnificent sailboat.

t: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Center / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle
d: When Motor needs help at the fire station, a new Fire Captain comes to town to help train all the pups as new firefighter recruits. // Charger can't wait to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show! Well, until his hurt paw causes a cone complication.

t: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane / The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor
d: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south. // Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic... so the pups build a special space just for her!

t: PAW Patrol S10 - Pups Save a High-Flying Hen / Pups Save a Sloth
d: After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the Paw Patrol to rescue her. // Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey. He races the Paw Patrol to find it when it goes missing to cover up his blunder.

t: PAW Patrol S10 - Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub / Pups Save a Drive-in
d: When a storm sends a polar bear cub to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family. // The Pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector at the new drive-in.

t: Deer Squad S1 - Switcheroo / Protect The Egg
d: Professor Scratch's Switcheroo device causes chaos when Sir Steel uses it to get Deer Squad's Powers. // Rammy must learn to trust his friends when he chooses to take care of an abandoned egg, all while dealing with a mysterious ant invasion.

t: Blue's Clues & You S3 - Magenta's Case of the Giggles
d: Josh and Blue are pretending to be doctors around the house, giving silly checkups to friends, but one 'patient' seems to have a curious condition. We'll play Blue's Clues to help find the cure!

t: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Walky Talky / Brothers / Blob Monster
d: Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to it's owner. // Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip, but soon disagree on what to do first. // When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

t: Rubble & Crew S5 - The Crew Builds A Giant Rock-Climbing Wall / The Crew Builds A Giant Octo-Sandbox
d: Rubble & Crew use their vehicles to 'rock climb' up a giant mountain to rescue Speed Meister! // When there's no room to play inside a sandbox, the pups build a giant octopus with eight sides leading to different sandboxes to play in!

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Tomas's Birthday Surprise / Family Treasure Hunt
d: Santiago, Lorelai and Abuelo traverse treacherous waters to bring Tomas a special birthday surprise. // It's a good ol' fashioned family competition as everyone pairs up to find the fabled treasure of La Caverna Secreta.

t: DORA S4 - Dora & Diego Rescue Baby Jaguar / Diego's Awesome Owl Adventure
d: Dora, Boots, and Diego rescue a baby jaguar after it gets lost deep in the rainforest. // Dora, Boots, and Diego help a baby burrowing owl find its parents and make it home.

t: Blue's Clues & You S4 - Return of the Thinking Squad
d: It's a bird! It's a plane! No, it's a clue! The Thinking Squad needs to find all three clues to figure out how to stop the dastardly Villain Ice before he freezes Super City. Thinking Squad, to the rescue!

t: Mr. Crocodile S1 - Cluc Croc / One Tree Home
d: Mr. Crocodile joins gymnastics club because Daisy loves it. // Mr. Crocodile and Daisy help Gigi and Roland find separate homes when they don't want to share a tree anymore.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Living Together / Holey The Snowman
d: For the very first time, the Barbababies will take the train and sleep in a hotel. // Barbouille crafted a magnificent snowman that the children named Bobo.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Mountain Eater / The First Day Of School
d: Barbapapa tells the Barbababies about his extraordinary encounter with a wolf. // Tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school.

t: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Shooting Star / Ball / Balloon
d: Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid. // Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom. // Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.

t: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Present / Movie / Vinny
d: Tim, Tommy and Tia can't decide on the best gift for Grandma. // Tim tries to make his own Captain DinoStar movie. // Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.

t: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Rocket Race / Magic / Parents
d: Tommy is in a Rocket Race, Tim supports his brother. // Tim distracts Tia when Tusky is in the washing machine. // The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.

t: Rubble & Crew S5 - The Crew Builds A Fish Ladder / The Crew Builds A Construction Carnival
d: When the dam blocks salmon from swimming upstream, Rubble & Crew build a ladder so they can swim over the dam! // When the carnival can't make it to town, the pups build a special 'Construction Carnival' with construction-themed games and rides!

t: Rubble & Crew S1 - The Crew Builds A Giant Dam / The Crew Builds A Squirrel-Proof Farm
d: Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town. // Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair.

t: PAW Patrol S1 - Pups Save a Pool Day / Circus Pup-Formers
d: It's a hot day and the pups head for the water park - but the pool is empty! Paw Patrol to the rescue. // When the animals don't show up in time for the Circus to start; Ryder and the Paw Patrol step in to help.

t: Deer Squad S1 - Fan Club / Speeding Steel
d: After Kai saves some baby turtles, they form a fan club. Full of himself, Kai tries to save the Central Forest from over-heating without his teammates. // Rammy wants to win the city marathon but he cannot keep up with Sir Steel's super sneakers!

t: DORA S1 - Friendaversary Adventure / Swiper's Birthday Surprise
d: Boots and Dora journey to Banana Hill to bring Isa a Friendiversary gift - a flowerpot that Boots painted himself! // Dora and friends throw Swiper a surprise birthday party. On the way to the party, Swiper attempts to swipe his own surprise present.

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Cecilia and the Magic Rubies / Under the Pirate Moon
d: Santi and crew go underwater to stop Escarlata la Pirata before she steals all the Magic Rubies from Giant Clam Reef! // It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

t: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Surf / Spaceship / Pizza
d: Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick. // Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship. // Tim tries to rid the house of a troublesome space bug.

t: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Talent Show
d: Tim, Tia & Tommy decide to put on a talent show, but then they can't decide who should go first...

t: Blue's Clues & You S3 - Something New at Blue's School
d: Join Josh and Blue at school for a day of trying new things! Josh is excited to try being Teacher for the Day, but Blue seems nervous to try something. What could it be?

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - The Barbapapa Tree / The Barbababies' birthday
d: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under. It's in bad condition. They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals. // It's the Barbababies's birthday. They all want to do something different with Barbapapa!

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Birth / The Revelation
d: Young Francois witnesses the birth of Barbapapa. // Barbapapa is a prisoner in a zoo.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Barbapapa Family / The House of Barbapapa
d: Barbapapa finds refuge in the house that Francois' parents built for him. // The house of Barbapapa is far too small now that Barbamama and the Barbabebe have arrived in his life.

t: Mr. Crocodile S2 - New Rules / Lemonade
d: After damaging a patch of grass, Daisy and Mr. Crocodile go overboard trying to prevent another mishap. // When Mr. Crocodile and Daisy set up a lemonade stand, Winston competes with his blueberry-ade.

t: The Creature Cases S1 - The Legend of the Night Howler / The Haystack Stakeout
d: Sam and Kit track a legendary creature who's spreading an unstoppable itch among prairie dogs. // Who would steal a cute forest pika's dry flower pile?

t: Rubble & Crew S5 - The Crew Builds A Fish Ladder / The Crew Builds A Construction Carnival
d: When the dam blocks salmon from swimming upstream, Rubble & Crew build a ladder so they can swim over the dam! // When the carnival can't make it to town, the pups build a special 'Construction Carnival' with construction-themed games and rides!

t: Rubble & Crew S4 - The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard / The Crew Builds a Corn Silo
d: Coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids! But when everyone can't play together, Rubble & Crew save the day with construction. / Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoe's farm.

t: PAW Patrol S3 - Pups Save the Polar Bears / A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
d: Ryder and the pups must fly to the Arctic in the Air Patroller to rescue the lost cubs. // When little lambs keep running away from Farmer Al's pasture, it's up to the Paw Patrol to find the missing sheep.

t: PAW Patrol S3 - Pups Save a School Bus / Pups Save the Songbirds
d: When all the tires on the Adventure Bay school bus blow out, Ryder volunteers to use the Paw Patroller as a substitute school bus. // When the famous singing songbirds of Adventure Bay go missing, it's PAW Patrol to the rescue!

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
d: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
d: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

t: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Barba TV / The Museum
d: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows. // The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the Earth, Precambrian submarine and... dinosaurs!

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Santiago and Bonnie to the Rescue / The Compass Caper
d: After getting stranded at the bottom of a crevice, Bonnie and Santiago must team up to save the day. // Santiago is on a mad dash to get his compass back after it's nabbed by Bonnie Bones and Sir Butterscotch.

t: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Triton's Trumpet / The Curse of the Pirate Baby
d: Santiago and crew must retrieve a powerful undersea artifact after it's stolen by Enrique. // Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and it's up to the good pirates to change her back.

t: Blue's Clues & You S4 - Blue's Countdown Celebration
d: We've danced together, we've sang so many incredible songs, and now Josh and Blue are celebrating the best musical moments with an epic Top Ten Song Countdown! They can't wait to find out...what is the #1 song?

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Champion Daddy Pig
d: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper during the Daddi-Olympics, so everyone helps him train to win it back at the Daddi-Olympics.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Chatterbox
d: Peppa Pig talks far too much. Or at least so Suzy thinks. In response, Peppa decides that she is never going to talk, ever again. But this does not last for very long at all.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Mr Fox's Van
d: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken!

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Chloe's Big Friends
d: Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any "baby" games.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Gym Class
d: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where at first they think all the stuff to do is scary, but Grampy Rabbit tells the kids about how he explored a jungle, helping the kids get over their fears.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - The Blackberry Bush
d: Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Pottery
d: Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Paper Aeroplanes
d: Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing - because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper airplanes.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - Edmond Elephant's Birthday
d: Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they expected.

t: Peppa Pig S4 - The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World
d: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island!

t: Peppa Pig S5 - Potato City
d: Peppa and her family visit a new theme park that has a vegetable theme.

t: Peppa Pig S5 - The New House
d: Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. Will they find out who their new neighbors are?

t: DORA S3 - Unicornasaurus / The Grumple Games
d: Dora helps Benny and Uni the Unicornasaurus get their magic paintbrush back so he can be reunited with his pet, Bunnicorn. // Dora teams up with Hearty the Grumple so she can finally compete in the Grumple Games.

t: DORA S4 - Bruno And The Bunny Boyz
d: Dora and Boots help Bruno the Bunny find his own special dance moves in time to perform with his favorite band, the Bunny Boyz!
